description: Traceable Mercury .mryx exports for independent format validation. Derived anonymized fixtures are vendored under tests/data/mryx/fixtures/; CI and default tests use bundled bytes only (no runtime download).

derivation.python_contract: Not stdlib gzip.compress: header OS differs across CPython minors. derive_fixture pins mtime=0/OS=255/XFL=2 and raw deflate via compressobj(wbits=-15) for CPython 3.10–3.12 byte identity.
